name: Isla Joseph
life: “I still remember planning a reception nobody thought to pay the cleaners for.” On Friday, near the blocks below Foundry Lofts, Isla checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I booked the party and invited my millionaire boss. I can cancel my own celebration without canceling everybody's wages.
appearance: Isla has close-cropped dark curls, heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a washed violet jersey. It usually goes with one loose pocket corner secured with green thread. When somebody else has the floor, Isla listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Isla has a long memory for unfair prices and a short one for small insults. Isla can get along perfectly well with an enemy provided the account between them is clear.
agenda: To cancel the private celebration without canceling wages.
family: Anna Bishop is Isla’s older cousin. Isla is free to hang up first. Anna makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The clean ledger*, Anna says, “I want my niece's graduation dress back. A price in a notebook won't fit her.”
connections: Karim Byrd. A worker hoping to gain clients speaks directly with the person who booked the unpaid promotion.
